author: Codex, prepared for Pranjal Prajapati
construction: Sixteen new case-specific authored mechanisms and keyframes. Shared baseline telemetry and renderer with authored-v1; no random sampling or procedural fault templates.
review_status: Single-author causal and structural review; no independent human or domain-expert review. Designed after inspecting authored-v1 policy failures.

cases.title: Auth release reads the wrong signing-key slot
cases.narrative: Auth a204 changes the signing-key slot from active to retired at minute 55. All instances reject otherwise valid sessions immediately after activation. Cache lookups still succeed and traffic is flat. Roll back auth; the cache flag changed later is unrelated.
distractors: A cache diagnostics flag at minute 57 changes tracing only, after the first rejected session.

logs.msg: build a204 selects retired key slot 0; token issued by active slot 1 rejected
same token accepted on a203 and rejected on a204; cache session lookup succeeds
diagnostic sampling enabled; read latency and hit rate unchanged

events.detail: Verifier key-slot selector changed; no issuer or clock configuration changed.
Only spans are sampled; serving path unchanged.

cases.title: Order release overflows a cents conversion
cases.narrative: Orders o307 narrows a 64-bit cents accumulator to 16 bits. Large baskets fail while the same database operations continue to succeed. Orders logs are absent; gateway error payloads identify the conversion and the release. Roll back orders, rather than fail over postgres.
distractors: A postgres maintenance notice at minute 71 reports successful replication with no serving interruption.

logs.msg: orders o307 response: cents accumulator overflow for basket total 98500; previous o306 accepted same basket
replica maintenance complete; primary accepts reads and commits in 24ms

events.detail: Primary address and query execution are unchanged.
Money conversion helper rebuilt; external basket schema unchanged.

cases.title: Order pool reduced while database remains idle
cases.narrative: A live orders configuration reduces pool capacity from 48 to 2 at minute 62. Requests queue locally while postgres has spare connections and normal latency. A prior receipt-only deploy did not change the pool. Revert orders configuration.
distractors: Orders o218 shipped receipt formatting six minutes earlier and passed the original 48-slot pool check.

logs.msg: config refresh: outbound_db_pool.max_clients 48 -> 2
local pool 2/2 busy; 158 requests queued; postgres acquisition rejected before network send
active clients 32 of 200; accepted order queries finish in 25ms

events.detail: Receipt labels only; pool remained 48 and acceptance probes passed.
max_clients changed from 48 to 2.

cases.title: Payment deadline drops below normal commit time
cases.narrative: A payments runtime timeout refresh changes database deadline from 800ms to 8ms. Normal commits take 24ms and the listener remains healthy. A nearby postgres index maintenance event finishes before symptoms. Revert payments timeout configuration, not the database.
distractors: Postgres index statistics refresh ended at minute 80 and neither holds locks nor slows commits.

logs.msg: deadline refresh applied: ledger_commit_ms=8, previous=800
ledger deadline at 8ms; server commit acknowledgement arrives at 24ms; client cancelled first
ledger commits 24ms, lock waits 4ms; no rejected connections

events.detail: Refresh completed at minute 80; schema and indexes unchanged.
Ledger timeout unit remains milliseconds; value changed 800 to 8.

cases.title: Auth audit buffers accumulate under constant load
cases.narrative: Auth a91 retains every completed audit buffer after a minute-48 release. Memory rises for an hour at stable request volume before restarts. Cache reads remain fast. Roll back the leaking auth build; increasing replicas would not repair per-request retention.
distractors: An unrelated cache maintenance flag toggles at minute 92, long after auth memory begins growing.

logs.msg: audit-buffer registry has 180000 completed entries; completed buffers never removed
heap dominated by completed audit buffers; input remains 200 requests/s
session reads complete in 8ms; no evictions or refused requests

events.detail: Completed audit buffers now retained by registry.
Only background counters enabled.

cases.title: Search leaves temporary result handles open
cases.narrative: Search s118 leaks a temporary result handle for each query after minute 52. Demand and CPU remain flat, but after handle exhaustion new queries fail. Root logs are absent; gateway receives an explicit descriptor-exhaustion response. Roll back search.
distractors: Gateway connection logging changes at minute 97, after handle exhaustion starts, without changing routing.

logs.msg: search s118 replied: EMFILE temporary result handles exhausted; open=65535, closed_since_boot=0
gateway socket count stable; other upstream routes complete normally

events.detail: Result handles created per query; close-on-completion hook removed.
Serving routes and connection limits unchanged.

cases.title: Payments listener reaches certificate expiry
cases.narrative: Payments keeps healthy application workers but its serving certificate expires at minute 66. Orders sees certificate validity errors before HTTP dispatch; the payments deploy at minute 60 still passed TLS at minute 61. Renew the payments certificate.
distractors: A payments receipt-text release precedes expiry, but the same binary served successfully while the certificate was valid.

logs.msg: TLS verify payments peer: notAfter minute 66 is earlier than current time 109; HTTP request not sent
receipt release p74 handshake and ledger acceptance passed
worker loop healthy; no incoming HTTP calls since minute 66

events.detail: Certificate and listener configuration were not changed.

cases.title: Auth TLS expires after an unrelated route refresh
cases.narrative: Auth application error metrics stay flat because the TLS listener rejects sessions before dispatch. Its certificate expires at minute 91. Gateway route reload at minute 87 preserves the auth endpoint. Renew auth TLS instead of reverting gateway routing.
distractors: The newest gateway route event keeps both the auth upstream address and trust store unchanged.

logs.msg: auth handshake rejected: peer leaf certificate validity ended minute 91; configured endpoint unchanged
signer and session checks healthy; no application exceptions

events.detail: Auth endpoint and CA trust bundle unchanged; only orders weights adjusted.

probes.contains: Auth endpoint and CA trust bundle unchanged

cases.title: Checkout replay multiplies orders arrivals
cases.narrative: A client reconnect bug replays checkout requests, lifting orders arrivals from 160 to 1920 per second at minute 58. CPU saturates and queueing follows. The orders binary and per-request work are unchanged; payments latency remains normal. Scale orders for the surge.
distractors: Payments p43 deploys at minute 55 but remains responsive; it cannot explain upstream orders queue saturation.

logs.msg: reconnect clients submitted 1760 extra checkouts/s; queue admission shedding excess work
handler duration without queue remains 120ms; same build o66
accepted payment calls complete in 90ms; no handler errors

events.detail: Receipt padding only; transaction path unchanged.

cases.title: Partner fan-out increases search arrivals
cases.narrative: A partner dashboard starts issuing twelve search requests for each refresh, raising total search RPS from 140 to 1680 at minute 77. Search logs are missing. Gateway access counts identify new demand; a search deploy at minute 69 served baseline load successfully. Scale search.
distractors: Search s73 shipped before the surge and passed steady-load probes; its payload cost stayed unchanged.

logs.msg: partner dashboard now fans out twelve search requests per refresh; unique user count unchanged
search response size and successful request duration unchanged outside admission queue

events.detail: Baseline 140 requests/s probe passed at minute 70; query plan unchanged.

cases.title: Ledger column rename breaks unchanged payment queries
cases.narrative: A postgres migration renames amount_cents to amount_minor at minute 63 without a compatibility view. The unchanged payments binary still queries amount_cents. Database connections and other tables remain healthy. Roll back the migration, not payments.
distractors: Payments p61 deploys formatting only after the database rename; its SQL fingerprint is unchanged from p60.

logs.msg: DDL m208 renamed ledger.amount_cents to amount_minor; no compatibility alias created
SQLSTATE 42703: column ledger.amount_cents does not exist; statement fingerprint unchanged
release p61 and p60 use identical ledger SELECT fingerprint

events.detail: amount_cents renamed to amount_minor; dependent application query not migrated.
SQL query fingerprint unchanged from p60.

cases.title: Quantity type narrowing rejects valid large stock values
cases.narrative: Postgres migration m311 narrows stock quantities to a signed small integer. Previously valid quantities above 32767 fail, while small updates and connections remain healthy. Inventory flag changes only formatting. Roll back the database type migration.
distractors: Inventory output flag changes one minute later but no longer runs when the database rejects a write.

logs.msg: m311 changed inventory_levels.quantity bigint -> smallint
SQLSTATE 22003 smallint out of range for quantity 50000; quantity 120 write succeeds
stock format flag executes after database success; failing write never reaches formatting

events.detail: Quantity type narrowed to smallint; application quantity range unchanged.
Presentation only after completed stock transaction.

cases.title: Cache process stops while postgres remains available
cases.narrative: The cache process stops at minute 71 and its listener refuses connections. Auth, inventory and search fail one minute later while database operations continue normally. A search configuration change occurs after the outage. Fail over cache.
distractors: Search increases result limits at minute 73, after independent cache callers already fail.

logs.msg: serving process exited; listener 6379 closed
cache connect refused at 6379; no TLS negotiation occurred
postgres stock lookup completes in 25ms while cache connect is refused

events.detail: Applied after cache caller failures; cache endpoint unchanged.

cases.title: Database public listener loses its serving socket
cases.narrative: Postgres maintenance agent closes the public serving socket at minute 94 while its local admin process remains healthy. Orders and payments see TCP refusal before SQL. A payments rollout had succeeded beforehand; migration locks cannot explain failures before connection establishment. Fail over postgres.
distractors: Payments p83 deploys at minute 89; a pre-outage acceptance check confirms successful commits.

logs.msg: public serving socket 5432 closed by maintenance agent; admin unix socket still responds
database TCP 5432 ECONNREFUSED before SQL dispatch; no server transaction exists
p83 acceptance: commit acknowledged in 25ms

events.detail: Receipt footer only; acceptance commit passed at minute 90.

cases.title: Search explanation flag adds synchronous model work
cases.narrative: Search s205 ships an optional explanation path disabled at minute 60. A flag turns it on at minute 68; every result waits on CPU-heavy explanation work. Traffic remains flat and cache responds normally. Disable search explanations instead of rolling back the earlier code.
distractors: The search release passes a dark-path canary eight minutes before the flag activation.

logs.msg: s205 dark-path check: explanations_enabled=false; ordinary ranking 95ms
explanations_enabled=true; per-result explanation pass 2200ms before response
search cache reads 8ms with 96 percent hit rate; no evictions

events.detail: Flag default false; ordinary ranking unchanged.
Synchronous explanation work enabled for all queries.

cases.title: Orders audit mirror becomes a blocking response gate
cases.narrative: Orders o402 already contains a nonblocking audit mirror. A minute-86 flag changes the mirror into a synchronous response gate. Orders logs are missing; gateway sees the named flag and traces isolate the wait to orders after healthy payments and postgres spans. Disable the orders flag.
distractors: Payments p121 updates receipt wording at minute 84 but payments calls continue to finish in 90ms.

logs.msg: orders response metadata: audit_mirror_blocking=true, wait_for_ack_ms=2700
p121 ledger calls 90ms; no audit-mirror wait in payments

events.detail: Transaction logic unchanged; acceptance latency 90ms.
Changes existing mirror from background delivery to response gate; orders binary o402 unchanged.

spans.note: audit mirror acknowledgement gated by audit_mirror_blocking=true
